additional_info.subject: ID0439647-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/T2314142728001] Charger doesn't connect to vehicle CRM:02919000227
additional_info.body:
Hello Sven, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I have restarted the service responsible for the authentication. Can you please perform a charging session and provide me a time and date, if it worked or not?
The reason why we are not able to charge is because there is a problem with the OCPP command StartTransaction. Can you tell me from your backend when was the last time you performed a successfull charging session?
Thank you very much and I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
